core_obligations: Uniqueness: S(X) represents the dual Hom functor, hence is unique up to unique isomorphism; arrows are determined functorially.
Shift compatibility: the canonical isomorphism S(X[1]) -> S(X)[1] is built from four Hom dualities.
Exactness: the S-image of a distinguished triangle induces the k-linear dual long exact sequence; the 5-lemma gives full faithfulness of Hom(-, E) comparison and the matress condition produces phi.
proof_roadmap: Build the shift isomorphism, then compare S-image triangles with a chosen TR1/TR2 triangle through dual long exact sequences.
Produce the dotted arrow phi via the dual matress; conclude the image triangle is distinguished.
difficulty_reason: Yoneda uniqueness plus a long-exact-sequence duality argument and a matress construction of the comparison arrow; multi-step diagram content.
